issue.title: Solstice heatmap upgrade (Rev-3 T00–T29, read-only)
issue.body:
## Solstice heatmap upgrade — Revision-3 plan, tickets T00–T29 (read-only)

Implements the full Solstice heat-map specification while preserving the
mounted dark terminal, palette, dense 2D grid, layout, scroller and zoom.
**No live trades, no credential changes. Execution stays disarmed.**

> [!NOTE]
> This branch stacks open PR #11 (`5db4971a`, retry-404) — base local `main`
> already contains it. Diff vs `origin/main` therefore includes the RetryButton
> change; review #11 separately or land it first.

### What changed
- **Truth first (P0):** exact actual/365 0DTE clock; vendor-gamma canonical
  engine (supplied-gamma change must change output); bid/ask/last source
  timestamps preserved (null stays null); SPX index instrument resolver;
  scalp mode emits a real 2D grid; unknown-first lifecycle/velocity
  (tap_prob None); upstream age survives caches; exposure_basis everywhere.
- **Grid (P1):** Raw/Δ-weighted/Activity overlays from the same snapshot
  (walls raw-locked); stable zero-anchor scale; scope-keyed change badges;
  largest-cell vs strongest-wall labeling; scope-preserving expand; App.js
  single-flight + freshness-derived liveness (surgical).
- **Desk:** wall registry + interaction machine + inspector/scenarios,
  corrected regime/roots, 5-pattern library, Vanna/Vomma split,
  enrichment, side-first 0DTE scout, session permissions, whole-contract
  sizing, DuckDB v2 recorder + available-at replay + manifest + compare,
  evidence packet + 8-case AI eval corpus, missed-opportunity ledger,
  Q1/Q2/Q3 frozen protocols, 27-op capability registry, longevity/migration.
- **Contracts (disarmed):** cancel→DELETE, multileg `type`, v2 order fields,
  replace/search/v2/strategy-quote wrappers — mocked tests only.
- **Parity:** Rust max-pain ported to call/put intrinsic + basis key.

### Verification
- `backend/tests/solstice/`: 52 passed (incl. 13+1 mutation/parity canaries)
- `cargo test` (rust/decoder-core): 29 passed
- Targeted backend: 128+ passed; `check_silent_excepts.py`: OK (280 files)
- Ruff clean on all touched files; frontend heatseeker: 24 suites / 92 passed
- Full backend suite: 5182+ passed; remaining 40F/27E all in untouched files,
  verified identical on stashed tree. Full frontend: 576/2, both inherited.
- Commissioning: `scripts/solstice_commission.py` 6/6 offline; account probes
  BLOCKED (no key/approval) — see STATUS.md.

### Rollback
Additive only — core grid never depends on new keys. Rollback = stop reading
them. Receipt: `docs/solstice/STATUS.md`. **Do not merge without separate
explicit authorization.**

## Solstice sweep-5 — missed-items from the Rev-3 plan (read-only, additive)

Follow-up to #13 (merged). Closes §8 grid gaps and operability gaps found in
resweep. No live trades, no credential changes, execution stays disarmed.

### Changes
- **Grid depth:** strike-rail gross-concentration bars (no cancellation),
  expiry headers with exact date + days-left + column coverage, 0DTE share of
  matrix gross — all client-side from the same snapshot.
- **Recording:** opt-in `FLOWW_SOLSTICE_CAPTURE` scheduler (default OFF,
  6-ticker cap, 60s floor, market-hours guard, paced, fresh builds only) so
  history grows without an open tab.
- **Docs:** `SOURCES.md` adoption register (28 texts + cheat sheet);
  capability registry carries docs base + review date; STATUS slice 5.
- **Tests:** row=cell=aggregate reconciliation test, scheduler config test,
  grid conc-bar/0DTE tests.

### Verification

- Ruff clean on touched files; silent-except gate OK (280 files)
- Frontend grid/slice/dash: 3 suites / 17 passed
- Full-suite baselines unchanged (remaining failures pre-existing, verified
  on stashed tree). Rollback: additive only.

**Do not merge without separate explicit authorization.**

- **Real bug:** `event_envelope` tuple `or`-chaining always took the first
  parse result, breaking alternate timestamp keys; naive timestamps now
  UTC-normalize with an explicit `naive_assumed_utc` flag (mixed naive/aware
  no longer raises) — F24.
- `compare_snapshots` gains rebase-quarantined per-strike window volume
  deltas; ReplayStrip gets a Compare-last-two session control (1m/5m/15m
  honestly marked unavailable).
- Vanna = dVega/dSpot finite-difference cross-check + vomma distinction (F20).
- STATUS slice 6 (+ slice-5 heading repair).

### Verification
- Solstice + envelope: 66 passed; ruff + silent gate clean; frontend 24/94.
- Full-suite baselines unchanged (remaining failures pre-existing).
- Rollback: additive only.

issue.title: Solstice sweep-9: payload interactions, file-backed DuckDB, reconciliation + frozen protocol
issue.body:
## Solstice sweep-9 — net-new follow-through (read-only, additive)

Follow-up to #13–#17 (all merged). Verified no overlap with #17 (deduplicated
byte-identical convergent work; kept only net-new changes).

### Changes
- **T07:** `interactions` + `scenarios` attached to the heatmap payload (same
  snapshot for UI inspector and AI evidence); inspector renders
  state/event/touches with unknown-first semantics.
- **T09:** `DUCKDB_PATH` file backing for the shared engine with crash-safe
  memory fallback (research history can now survive restarts).
- **T24:** scheduler config test (cap/floor behavior).
- **T29:** `RECONCILIATION.md` (merged PRs vs master-plan status table) and
  `FROZEN_PROTOCOL.md` (frozen hypotheses/baselines/params/outcomes/costs;
  collection inventory: 2 snapshots, 0 outcome events — collection phase).

### Verification
- Solstice + envelope: 70 passed; ruff + silent gate clean; frontend 24/97.
- Rollback: additive only.

issue.title: R4 P01+P02: audit reconciliation, immutable snapshots, typed quality, strict evidence
issue.body:
## Revision-4 P01 (reconcile) + P02 (snapshot and quality)

Implements the R4 audit's first repair packages against `main@5f325e10`.
No merges performed by this PR; no live calls; execution stays disarmed.

### P01
`RECONCILIATION.md` gains per-finding verdicts: R4-01–R4-04 repaired here
with red-first evidence; R4-05–R4-18 confirmed by inspection/code and mapped
to P03–P12 targets.

### P02
- **Snapshot identity (R4-01):** ID binds canonical content digest
  (normalized strikes/cells, scope, metric/formula versions, provenance) plus
  observation time; payload deep-copied at build; recorder digest delegates.
- **Quality (R4-02):** one typed adapter, unknown-first (missing → unavailable/
  ineligible), reason codes preserved, source/receipt/compute clocks separate.
- **Evidence (R4-03):** `/evidence` serves recorded-ID replay or full-scope
  rebuild with identical query keys; packets carry wall/scope/formula facts.
- **Validator (R4-04):** complete schema, citation per observation, typed
  number↔fact binding, untrusted-text quarantine, failure≠pass, real
  injections delivered to the packet.

### Verification
- Red-first: 7/8 new tests failed on baseline, 8/8 pass after.
- `backend/tests/solstice/`: 68 passed. Ruff + silent-except gate clean.
- Rollback: additive; legacy payload shape unchanged.

issue.body:
